item.title: Show HN: Adblock-rust Manager – Firefox extension to enable the Brave ad blocker
item.description:
📝 adblock-rust Manager A Firefox extension that enables and manages Firefox's built-in adblock-rust engine — Brave's open-source, Rust-based ad and tracker blocking engine, quietly shipped in Firefox 149. 📝 Filter list manager — Add, remove, and reorder filter lists. adblock-rust is now active with your chosen filter lists.
🔗 Read more: https://github.com/electricant/adblock-rust-manager

item.title: Notepad++ Code Editor Comes to Mac After 20-Year Wait
item.description:
📝 Notepad++ Code Editor Comes to Mac After 20-Year WaitWednesday April 29, 2026 1:29 am PDT by Tim HardwickThe popular Notepad++ coding editor is now available as a native macOS app, following a successful open-source community port of the original Windows codebase. Notepad++ for macOS is maintained by Andrey Letov, who wrote the Objective-C++ Cocoa UI that replaces Notepad++'s Win32 front-end. The app is available to download from the Notepad++ website.
🔗 Read more: https://www.macrumors.com/2026/04/29/notepad-plus-plus-editor-comes-to-mac/
